message:
Well, now I know what the West coast reference was in an earlier posting.  Crossing the country twice for a short visit is always draining, though I  do it the other direction.

I  think your reward system of a mystery per chapter makes eminent sense.  I used to read a "trash" novel the end of every term.  I  thought of it as cleansing, like putting snails in corn meal  to clear itheir digestive tracts.
